api.purpose: FastAPI REST API - HTTP endpoints, request routing, response serialization
api.l0: Provides REST API for competitive intelligence queries and data export

submodules.routes: Request handlers for specific endpoints (companies, analysis, exports)

api.patterns: FastAPI router pattern, dependency injection via get_db

domain.purpose: Domain Models - Core business entities and validation
domain.l0: Defines Company, Competitor, Threat, and related value objects

models.Company: Main entity - stores company info, competitors, threats, scores
models.AIMaturity: Company AI capability level for competitive threat assessment

connectors.purpose: Data Source Connectors - Interface to external APIs and data sources
connectors.l0: Abstract connector pattern + implementations for 6 data categories

categories.financial: Yahoo Finance, SEC Edgar, Crunchbase, OpenCorporates
categories.government: USAspending, PatentsView, WHOIS, DNS, Wayback Machine

connectors.base_class: BaseConnector with async fetch(), parse(), validate() methods

data.purpose: Data Processing Pipeline - ETL, normalization, enrichment
data.l0: Multi-stage data pipeline: connectors → converters → enrichment → unified

pipeline_stages.converters: Normalize different data formats to common schema
pipeline_stages.parsers: Extract structured info from unstructured data
pipeline_stages.unified: Single source of truth for all company data

analytics.purpose: Analytics Engine - Scoring, signals, simulation, valuation
analytics.l0: Compute competitive threat scores, AI adoption signals, market valuation

components.signals: Define and detect competitive signals (market moves, tech adoption)

llm.purpose: LLM Integration - Claude/GPT for analysis and query answering
llm.l0: Query LLMs for competitive analysis, health checks for availability

submodules.query: Send structured queries to LLMs, get analysis results
submodules.health: Monitor LLM service availability and performance

llm.usage: Analyze competitive data, generate insights, answer natural language questions

exporters.purpose: Export Engine - Generate Excel, Markdown, PDF reports
exporters.l0: Export company analysis in multiple formats for sharing/presentation

exceptions.purpose: Standardized Error Taxonomy - Maps to HTTP status codes
exceptions.l0: Custom exceptions hierarchy: SolsteinError → specific errors
exceptions.pattern: Each exception maps cleanly to HTTP status code

infrastructure.purpose: Infrastructure Models - Database, service connectors, deployments
infrastructure.l0: ORM models, connection pooling, deployment configuration

agents.purpose: LangGraph Agents - Workflow orchestration and autonomous processes
agents.l0: Multi-step workflows for data collection, analysis, decision-making

agents.github: Monitor GitHub org repos, commits, issues for competitive signals

security.purpose: Security & Authorization - Authentication, RBAC, audit logging
security.l0: User authentication, role-based access control, audit trail

monitoring.l0: System health, performance profiling, operational metrics

utils.purpose: Shared Utilities - Helpers, constants, common functions

patterns.architecture: Layered (API → Application → Domain → Data) with DDD principles
patterns.async: Async/await throughout with aiohttp for external API calls
patterns.dependency_injection: FastAPI dependency injection for database, config, current_user
patterns.error_handling: Custom exception hierarchy mapping to HTTP status codes
patterns.testing_strategy: 6-layer pyramid: unit, integration, e2e, performance, regression, compliance
patterns.data_flow: Connectors → Converters → Enrichment → Unified → Analytics → API

key_files_by_frequency.why: FastAPI app initialization, middleware, route registration
Core Company entity used by all modules

key_files_by_frequency.edits_expected: High - when adding data sources or processing

key_files_by_frequency.why: Central registry for all data connectors

tier_strategy.L0_abstract: ~100 tokens - Just purpose, main exports, data flow
tier_strategy.L1_overview: ~2000 tokens - Module structure, key classes, interfaces, patterns
tier_strategy.L2_full: On-demand - Complete source code with implementation details

examples.L0_query: What does the data module do?
examples.L1_query: Show me the data pipeline stages and key classes

asking_instructions.start_with_l0: Always ask for L0 (purpose + flow) first
asking_instructions.then_request_l1: If L0 makes sense, ask for L1 (structure + patterns)
asking_instructions.finally_request_l2: Only fetch L2 (full code) when you need implementation details
asking_instructions.save_tokens: This progression saves 91% tokens vs reading full files immediately
